scope: Post-refactor FP32 small-s1 dispatch and circular pad/crop only

operator.prior_shape: B in [1,4,8,32], C128, H96, W96, circular pad2, k3
operator.comparison: Full forward and x/weight/bias VJPs, no optimizer
operator.numeric: Require bitwise compatibility with frozen production; separately report zero-margin max_abs and relative_L2 noninferiority versus Python FP32 against identical FP64 reference
operator.failure_policy: Preserve inherited numerical failures; bitwise compatibility alone does not establish Python noninferiority

model.model: pretrained full USRNet, 5 iterations, 7 prior blocks, C64, HR96, s3
model.order: AB/BA/AB/BA; one GPU model at a time
model.numeric: Bitwise output, all final gradients, parameters, and Adam state after identical real-image batches
model.timing_scope: Resident inputs; includes zero_grad, forward, MSE, backward, Adam; excludes H2D, validation, IO, JIT and profiling
model.performance: At least 3% median paired improvement at B4, at least 3/4 B4 pairs improve, and no >5% median B1 regression; otherwise remain experimental

runtime: FP32, no AMP/TF32, cudnn deterministic=true, benchmark=false, no Graph, no spectrum reuse
profiling: Nsight Systems warm complete steps separately from formal timing; collect before and selected candidate
rollout: Only measured shapes; retain fallback. A path that fails Python noninferiority is not promoted solely because it matches current production. Longer quality/time-to-quality remains a separate claim.
